title: The Double Check
concept: A double check is when two of your pieces give check at the same time, usually by a discovered attack. The king cannot block or capture both, so it must move.
tip: Look for a move that gives check and uncovers a second check from the piece behind it.

feedback.correct: Brilliant! Two pieces give check at once — a double check! The king must move.
feedback.hint: Can you move a piece so it gives check AND uncovers a check from another piece?
feedback.reveal: When two pieces check the king at the same time, the king cannot block either attack — it has to run.
